newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TEENAGER RAUL INSURES LEGS FOR $15 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEENAGER RAUL INSURES LEGS FOR $15 MILLION.

text.p: Teenage striker Raul Gonzalez, who looks set to win his first cap for Spain in Wednesday's world cup qualifier against the Czech Republic, has insured his legs for two billion pesetas ($15.5 million).
Raul, 19, shot to prominence for Real Madrid two years ago and is the club's leading goalscorer this season despite being moved back to midfield by new coach Fabio Capello.
